hypotheses.claim: Rewriting score_ruin_nodes as score_i = rank_power(|savings_i|/scale * gate_load * gate_depot * gate_demand * gate_rdist, p(iter_frac, stagnation_ratio)) where p rises with stagnation (encourages diversification by flattening/boosting spread) and gate_load penalizes removing customers from near-full routes will reduce mean objective on dev_24 below SBS 16.0496, since the weakest regimes are tight-capacity (12 inst), size 100 (12), uniform demand (12) and clustered (8) where worst-cost removal over-focuses on the same high-savings nodes and stalls early.
